content.text: The plan specifies a public review-analysis app: import reviews, inspect sample quality, ask questions, and open the exact reviews behind each citation. I’ll keep its Kotlin/Vert.x and React stack, use local PostgreSQL for session-scoped datasets and quotas, and serve the frontend through Apache. The reference design uses a dark teal layout with a large editorial headline and an Ingest → Verify → Ask workflow.
